issues.problem: The curl omits the custom identifying User-Agent required by Jolpica's current documentation, and the response snippet retains Ergast's legacy xmlns value even though Jolpica returns an empty xmlns string.
issues.suggestion: Add a header such as -H 'User-Agent: APIDirectoryExample/1.0' and change MRData.xmlns to "" in the response snippet.

issues.problem: The value stops at the generic /apis prefix rather than the root of the endpoint family demonstrated by this entry.
issues.suggestion: Use https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2 as the base URL for these site-v2 sports endpoints.

issues.problem: It is null even though Etherscan offers paid Standard, Advanced, Professional, and higher/custom API plans; the rate_limits field itself mentions these tiers.
issues.suggestion: Populate paid_plans with the currently offered paid API tiers and link pricing to https://etherscan.io/apis.

issues.problem: “EU Open Data Portal” is a retired product name. The current data.europa.eu service replaced both the EU Open Data Portal and the former European Data Portal.
issues.suggestion: Rename the entry to “data.europa.eu Search API” or “European Data Portal Search API.”

issues.problem: GET /datasets with query and limit parameters is not the public catalogue-search interface. The current native search operation is POST /search with a JSON body; /datasets is used for dataset-management operations. The empty-object response is consequently not representative.
issues.suggestion: Use: curl -s -X POST 'https://data.europa.eu/api/hub/search/search' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"q":"climate","filters":["dataset"],"limit":1}' and replace the response with an actual search result.

issues.problem: The wskey query parameter is now deprecated. Europeana's preferred API-key mechanism is the X-Api-Key header.
issues.suggestion: State that X-Api-Key is preferred and that wskey is a deprecated compatibility mechanism.

issues.problem: The example teaches the deprecated practice of placing the key in the URL.
The hard-coded GDP value 14823456.7 does not match the current revised 2022 EU27_2020 value returned for this query.
issues.suggestion: Regenerate the response snippet from the live query; current Eurostat publications put the revised 2022 EU GDP at approximately 16,170,154 million euro.

issues.problem: Current REST documentation requires apiKey as a URL parameter or JSON request-body property; it does not document API-key authentication via a header.
issues.suggestion: Remove “or header” and document apiKey in the query string for GET requests or in the JSON body for POST requests.

issues.problem: The 2,000-token allowance is not a recurring monthly allowance. It is a one-time free testing allocation, described elsewhere by the provider as 2,000 free searches with no recurring monthly renewal.
issues.suggestion: Use “2,000 free tokens/searches total for testing; not renewed monthly; recent data is limited to the last 30 days.”

issues.problem: It is null even though Event Registry/NewsAPI.ai offers multiple paid token plans and custom plans.
issues.suggestion: Populate this field from the current NewsAPI.ai plans page.

issues.problem: A rate limit is published: no more than five simultaneous requests per user.
issues.suggestion: Set this to “Maximum 5 simultaneous requests; excess concurrent requests return HTTP 429.”

issues.problem: It is null even though Exa has published pay-as-you-go endpoint pricing and Enterprise/custom plans.
issues.suggestion: Populate paid_plans with Exa's current pay-as-you-go pricing and Enterprise option.

issues.problem: The phrase “1,500 requests/month free (Open Access)” conflates two distinct offerings. The keyed Free API plan has 1,500 requests/month, while the separate Open Access endpoint requires no key, requires attribution, and has different unpublished throttling.
issues.suggestion: Use “Keyed Free API plan: 1,500 requests/month.” If desired, document https://open.er-api.com/v6 separately as the unauthenticated Open Access product.

issues.problem: It says the free tier has daily request limits, but the keyed Free plan has a monthly 1,500-request quota. Once-per-day refers to the data update frequency, not a daily request quota.
issues.suggestion: Replace that sentence with “The keyed Free plan allows 1,500 requests per month and updates rates once per day.”

issues.problem: The listed 100-requests/day BASIC quota appears stale; current 2026 integrations report the RapidAPI free plan at about 10 requests/day. The paid quota figures may also be from an older plan revision.
issues.suggestion: Refresh every quota from the live RapidAPI pricing tab; use approximately 10 requests/day for BASIC only after confirming the currently displayed plan.

issues.suggestion: Populate paid_plans from the current RapidAPI listing.
